name: Uninformed Search Algorithms (BFS and DFS)
code:

% BFS
bfs(Start, Goal) :-
    bfs_queue([[Start]], Goal).

bfs_queue([[Goal|Path]|_], Goal) :-
    reverse([Goal|Path], Solution),
    write('Solution: '), write(Solution), nl.

bfs_queue([Path|Paths], Goal) :-
    extend(Path, NewPaths),
    append(Paths, NewPaths, UpdatedPaths),
    bfs_queue(UpdatedPaths, Goal).

extend([Node|Path], NewPaths) :-
    findall([NewNode, Node|Path],
            (edge(Node, NewNode), \+ member(NewNode, [Node|Path])),
            NewPaths),
    !.

extend(_, []).

% DFS
dfs(Start, End, Path) :-
    dfs_helper(Start, End, [], Path).

dfs_helper(Node, Node, Visited, [Node|Visited]).

dfs_helper(Current, End, Visited, Path) :-
    edge(Current, Next),
    \+ member(Next, Visited),
    dfs_helper(Next, End, [Current|Visited], Path).

dfs_start(Start, End) :-
    dfs(Start, End, Path),
    reverse(Path, PathReversed),
    format("DFS path from ~w to ~w: ~w", [Start, End, PathReversed]).

% Graph edges with transition step costs: edge(From, To, Cost)
edge(s, a, 1).
edge(s, b, 4).
edge(a, b, 2).
edge(a, c, 5).
edge(a, d, 12).
edge(b, c, 2).
edge(c, d, 3).
edge(c, g, 11).
edge(d, g, 2).

% Heuristic estimates to goal node 'g': h(Node, H_Value)
h(s, 7).
h(a, 6).
h(b, 4).
h(c, 2).
h(d, 1).
h(g, 0).

% A* Search: astar(Start, Goal)
astar(Start, Goal) :-
    h(Start, H0),
    astar_queue([H0-(0-[Start])], Goal, Path, Cost),
    format('~n=== A* Search Results ===~n', []),
    format('Optimal Path : ~w~n', [Path]),
    format('Total Cost   : ~w~n', [Cost]).

astar_queue([_-(Cost-[Goal|Rest])|_], Goal, Path, Cost) :-
    reverse([Goal|Rest], Path),
    !.

astar_queue([_-(G-[Current|Rest])|Others], Goal, Path, TotalCost) :-
    findall(
        NewF-(NewG-[Next, Current|Rest]),
        (
            edge(Current, Next, StepCost),
            \+ member(Next, [Current|Rest]),
            NewG is G + StepCost,
            h(Next, H),
            NewF is NewG + H
        ),
        Successors
    ),
    append(Others, Successors, Combined),
    keysort(Combined, SortedOpen),
    astar_queue(SortedOpen, Goal, Path, TotalCost).

% Greedy Best-First Search: best_first(Start, Goal)
best_first(Start, Goal) :-
    h(Start, H0),
    gbfs_queue([H0-[Start]], Goal, Path),
    format('~n=== Greedy Best-First Search Results ===~n', []),
    format('Greedy Path : ~w~n', [Path]).

gbfs_queue([_-[Goal|Rest]|_], Goal, Path) :-
    reverse([Goal|Rest], Path),
    !.

gbfs_queue([_-[Current|Rest]|Others], Goal, Path) :-
    findall(
        H-[Next, Current|Rest],
        (
            edge(Current, Next, _),
            \+ member(Next, [Current|Rest]),
            h(Next, H)
        ),
        Successors
    ),
    append(Others, Successors, Combined),
    keysort(Combined, SortedOpen),
    gbfs_queue(SortedOpen, Goal, Path).
note: Written in Prolog software (SWI-Prolog / GNU Prolog). Load the file and execute queries: ?- astar(s, g). for optimal A* path, or ?- best_first(s, g). for Greedy Best-First Search, or ?- solve_8puzzle([1, 2, 3, 4, 0, 6, 7, 5, 8]). for the 8-puzzle solver.

variants.label: 8-Puzzle Solver
variants.title: A* Search for the 8-Puzzle Problem
variants.description: Complete 8-puzzle sliding tile solver in Prolog using A* search with misplaced tiles heuristic function.
variants.code:
% 8-Puzzle Solver using A* Search in Prolog
% Blank tile is 0. Goal: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 0]

goal([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 0]).

solve_8puzzle(InitialState) :-
    heuristic(InitialState, H0),
    search_astar([H0-(0-[InitialState])], [], RevPath),
    reverse(RevPath, Path),
    length(Path, Len),
    Moves is Len - 1,
    format('~n=== 8-Puzzle Solved with A* ===~n', []),
    format('Total Moves to Solution: ~w~n~n', [Moves]),
    print_path(Path, 0).

search_astar([_-(_-[State|Rest])|_], _, [State|Rest]) :-
    goal(State),
    !.

search_astar([_-(G-[State|Path])|Queue], Visited, Solution) :-
    findall(
        F-(NewG-[NextState, State|Path]),
        (
            move(State, NextState),
            \+ member(NextState, [State|Path]),
            \+ member(NextState, Visited),
            NewG is G + 1,
            heuristic(NextState, H),
            F is NewG + H
        ),
        Children
    ),
    append(Queue, Children, Combined),
    keysort(Combined, SortedQueue),
    search_astar(SortedQueue, [State|Visited], Solution).

heuristic(State, H) :-
    goal(Goal),
    misplaced(State, Goal, 0, H).

misplaced([], [], Count, Count).
misplaced([0|T1], [_|T2], Acc, H) :- !, misplaced(T1, T2, Acc, H).
misplaced([X|T1], [X|T2], Acc, H) :- !, misplaced(T1, T2, Acc, H).
misplaced([_|T1], [_|T2], Acc, H) :-
    Acc1 is Acc + 1,
    misplaced(T1, T2, Acc1, H).

move(State, NextState) :-
    nth0(P0, State, 0),
    adjacent(P0, P1),
    nth0(P1, State, Tile),
    replace(State, P0, Tile, Temp),
    replace(Temp, P1, 0, NextState).

adjacent(0, 1). adjacent(1, 0).
adjacent(1, 2). adjacent(2, 1).
adjacent(3, 4). adjacent(4, 3).
adjacent(4, 5). adjacent(5, 4).
adjacent(6, 7). adjacent(7, 6).
adjacent(7, 8). adjacent(8, 7).
adjacent(0, 3). adjacent(3, 0).
adjacent(1, 4). adjacent(4, 1).
adjacent(2, 5). adjacent(5, 2).
adjacent(3, 6). adjacent(6, 3).
adjacent(4, 7). adjacent(7, 4).
adjacent(5, 8). adjacent(8, 5).

replace([_|T], 0, X, [X|T]) :- !.
replace([H|T], I, X, [H|R]) :-
    I > 0,
    I1 is I - 1,
    replace(T, I1, X, R).

print_path([], _).
print_path([State|Rest], Step) :-
    format('Step ~w:~n', [Step]),
    print_board(State),
    NextStep is Step + 1,
    print_path(Rest, NextStep).

print_board([A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I]) :-
    format(' ~w ~w ~w~n ~w ~w ~w~n ~w ~w ~w~n~n', [A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I]).

name: Adversarial Search: Minimax & Alpha-Beta Pruning
code:
% Game tree structure:
%          Root (a) [MAX]
%         /        \
%      b [MIN]     c [MIN]
%     /   \       /   \
%    d     e     f     g   (Terminal Leaves)
%   [3]   [5]   [6]   [9]

node(a, [b, c]).
node(b, [d, e]).
node(c, [f, g]).

terminal(d, 3).
terminal(e, 5).
terminal(f, 6).
terminal(g, 9).

% Minimax Algorithm
minimax(Node, _, Value, none) :-
    terminal(Node, Value),
    !.

minimax(Node, max, BestVal, BestMove) :-
    node(Node, Children),
    maximize(Children, -9999, none, BestVal, BestMove).

maximize([], BestVal, BestMove, BestVal, BestMove).
maximize([Child|Rest], CurrentMax, CurrentMove, BestVal, BestMove) :-
    minimax(Child, min, Val, _),
    ( Val > CurrentMax ->
        NewMax = Val, NewMove = Child
    ;
        NewMax = CurrentMax, NewMove = CurrentMove
    ),
    maximize(Rest, NewMax, NewMove, BestVal, BestMove).

minimax(Node, min, BestVal, BestMove) :-
    node(Node, Children),
    minimize(Children, 9999, none, BestVal, BestMove).

minimize([], BestVal, BestMove, BestVal, BestMove).
minimize([Child|Rest], CurrentMin, CurrentMove, BestVal, BestMove) :-
    minimax(Child, max, Val, _),
    ( Val < CurrentMin ->
        NewMin = Val, NewMove = Child
    ;
        NewMin = CurrentMin, NewMove = CurrentMove
    ),
    minimize(Rest, NewMin, NewMove, BestVal, BestMove).

run_minimax :-
    minimax(a, max, BestVal, BestMove),
    format('~n=== Minimax Search on Game Tree ===~n', []),
    format('Root Decision  : MAX plays to ~w~n', [BestMove]),
    format('Optimal Value  : ~w~n', [BestVal]).

% Alpha-Beta Pruning
node(root, [n1, n2]).
node(n1, [l1, l2]).
node(n2, [l3, l4]).
terminal(l1, 3).
terminal(l2, 5).
terminal(l3, 2).
terminal(l4, 9).

alphabeta(Node, _, _, _, Value, none) :-
    terminal(Node, Value),
    !.

alphabeta(Node, Alpha, Beta, max, Value, BestMove) :-
    node(Node, Children),
    max_eval(Children, Alpha, Beta, -9999, none, Value, BestMove).

max_eval([], _, _, Val, Move, Val, Move).
max_eval([Child|Rest], Alpha, Beta, CurrVal, CurrMove, FinalVal, FinalMove) :-
    alphabeta(Child, Alpha, Beta, min, ChildVal, _),
    ( ChildVal > CurrVal -> NextVal = ChildVal, NextMove = Child ; NextVal = CurrVal, NextMove = CurrMove ),
    NewAlpha is max(Alpha, NextVal),
    ( NewAlpha >= Beta ->
        FinalVal = NextVal, FinalMove = NextMove,
        format('Cutoff at ~w: Alpha (~w) >= Beta (~w)~n', [Child, NewAlpha, Beta])
    ;
        max_eval(Rest, NewAlpha, Beta, NextVal, NextMove, FinalVal, FinalMove)
    ).

alphabeta(Node, Alpha, Beta, min, Value, BestMove) :-
    node(Node, Children),
    min_eval(Children, Alpha, Beta, 9999, none, Value, BestMove).

min_eval([], _, _, Val, Move, Val, Move).
min_eval([Child|Rest], Alpha, Beta, CurrVal, CurrMove, FinalVal, FinalMove) :-
    alphabeta(Child, Alpha, Beta, max, ChildVal, _),
    ( ChildVal < CurrVal -> NextVal = ChildVal, NextMove = Child ; NextVal = CurrVal, NextMove = CurrMove ),
    NewBeta is min(Beta, NextVal),
    ( Alpha >= NewBeta ->
        FinalVal = NextVal, FinalMove = NextMove,
        format('Cutoff at ~w: Alpha (~w) >= Beta (~w)~n', [Child, Alpha, NewBeta])
    ;
        min_eval(Rest, Alpha, NewBeta, NextVal, NextMove, FinalVal, FinalMove)
    ).

run_alphabeta :-
    format('~n=== Minimax with Alpha-Beta Pruning ===~n', []),
    alphabeta(root, -9999, 9999, max, Score, Move),
    format('Optimal Root Decision : Move to ~w~n', [Move]),
    format('Evaluated Score       : ~w~n', [Score]).

    ( ChildVal > CurrVal -> NextVal = ChildVal, NextMove = Child ; NextVal = CurrVal, NextMove = CurrMove ),
    NewAlpha is max(Alpha, NextVal),
    ( NewAlpha >= Beta ->
        FinalVal = NextVal, FinalMove = NextMove,
        format('Alpha-Beta Cutoff at ~w: Alpha (~w) >= Beta (~w)~n', [Child, NewAlpha, Beta])
    ;
        max_eval(Rest, NewAlpha, Beta, NextVal, NextMove, FinalVal, FinalMove)
    ).

alphabeta(Node, Alpha, Beta, min, Value, BestMove) :-
    node(Node, Children),
    min_eval(Children, Alpha, Beta, 9999, none, Value, BestMove).

min_eval([], _, _, Val, Move, Val, Move).
min_eval([Child|Rest], Alpha, Beta, CurrVal, CurrMove, FinalVal, FinalMove) :-
    alphabeta(Child, Alpha, Beta, max, ChildVal, _),
    ( ChildVal < CurrVal -> NextVal = ChildVal, NextMove = Child ; NextVal = CurrVal, NextMove = CurrMove ),
    NewBeta is min(Beta, NextVal),
    ( Alpha >= NewBeta ->
        FinalVal = NextVal, FinalMove = NextMove,
        format('Alpha-Beta Cutoff at ~w: Alpha (~w) >= Beta (~w)~n', [Child, Alpha, NewBeta])
    ;
        min_eval(Rest, Alpha, NewBeta, NextVal, NextMove, FinalVal, FinalMove)
    ).

run_alphabeta :-
    format('~n=== Minimax with Alpha-Beta Pruning ===~n', []),
    alphabeta(root, -9999, 9999, max, Score, Move),
    format('Optimal Root Decision : Move to ~w~n', [Move]),
    format('Evaluated Score       : ~w~n', [Score]).

% Unbeatable Tic-Tac-Toe using Minimax in Prolog
% Board: 9-element list of x, o, or b (blank)

win(Board, P) :-
    ( Board = [P, P, P, _, _, _, _, _, _]
    ; Board = [_, _, _, P, P, P, _, _, _]
    ; Board = [_, _, _, _, _, _, P, P, P]
    ; Board = [P, _, _, P, _, _, P, _, _]
    ; Board = [_, P, _, _, P, _, _, P, _]
    ; Board = [_, _, P, _, _, P, _, _, P]
    ; Board = [P, _, _, _, P, _, _, _, P]
    ; Board = [_, _, P, _, P, _, P, _, _]
    ).

terminal_value(Board, 10)  :- win(Board, x), !.
terminal_value(Board, -10) :- win(Board, o), !.
terminal_value(Board, 0)   :- \+ member(b, Board), !.

minimax(Board, x, BestMove, BestScore) :-
    ( terminal_value(Board, BestScore) -> BestMove = 0
    ; findall(Score-Pos,
        (
            replace_blank(Board, Pos, x, NextBoard),
            minimax(NextBoard, o, _, Score)
        ),
        Moves),
      max_score(Moves, BestScore-BestMove)
    ).

minimax(Board, o, BestMove, BestScore) :-
    ( terminal_value(Board, BestScore) -> BestMove = 0
    ; findall(Score-Pos,
        (
            replace_blank(Board, Pos, o, NextBoard),
            minimax(NextBoard, x, _, Score)
        ),
        Moves),
      min_score(Moves, BestScore-BestMove)
    ).

max_score([H|T], Max) :- max_score(T, H, Max).
max_score([], Max, Max).
max_score([Score-Pos|T], CurrScore-CurrPos, Max) :-
    ( Score > CurrScore -> max_score(T, Score-Pos, Max) ; max_score(T, CurrScore-CurrPos, Max) ).

min_score([H|T], Min) :- min_score(T, H, Min).
min_score([], Min, Min).
min_score([Score-Pos|T], CurrScore-CurrPos, Min) :-
    ( Score < CurrScore -> min_score(T, Score-Pos, Min) ; min_score(T, CurrScore-CurrPos, Min) ).

replace_blank([b|T], 1, P, [P|T]).
replace_blank([H|T], Pos, P, [H|R]) :-
    Pos > 1,
    Pos1 is Pos - 1,
    replace_blank(T, Pos1, P, R).

best_move(Board, Move) :-
    minimax(Board, x, Move, Score),
    format('~nAI recommends Move to position: ~w (Expected Score: ~w)~n', [Move, Score]).

play :-
    Initial = [b, b, b, b, b, b, b, b, b],
    format('~n=== Tic-Tac-Toe: You are O, AI is X ===~n', []),
    print_board(Initial),
    game_loop(Initial, o).

game_loop(Board, _) :- win(Board, x), !, format('AI (X) Wins!~n', []).
game_loop(Board, _) :- win(Board, o), !, format('You (O) Win!~n', []).
game_loop(Board, _) :- \+ member(b, Board), !, format('It is a Draw!~n', []).

game_loop(Board, o) :-
    format('Your move (1-9): ', []),
    read(Pos),
    ( valid_move(Board, Pos) ->
        replace_blank_at(Board, Pos, o, NextBoard),
        print_board(NextBoard),
        game_loop(NextBoard, x)
    ;
        format('Position ~w is invalid or occupied. Try again.~n', [Pos]),
        game_loop(Board, o)
    ).

game_loop(Board, x) :-
    format('AI is thinking...~n', []),
    minimax(Board, x, BestMove, _),
    replace_blank_at(Board, BestMove, x, NextBoard),
    format('AI chooses position ~w:~n', [BestMove]),
    print_board(NextBoard),
    game_loop(NextBoard, o).

valid_move(Board, Pos) :-
    integer(Pos), Pos >= 1, Pos =< 9,
    nth1(Pos, Board, b).

replace_blank_at(Board, Pos, P, Next) :-
    replace_blank(Board, Pos, P, Next), !.

print_board([A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I]) :-
    format('~n ~w | ~w | ~w~n', [A, B, C]),
    format('---+---+---~n', []),
    format(' ~w | ~w | ~w~n', [D, E, F]),
    format('---+---+---~n', []),
    format(' ~w | ~w | ~w~n~n', [G, H, I]).

name: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
code:
# Run this install command in a separate Colab cell if needed:
# !pip install -q pypdf sentence-transformers faiss-cpu transformers torch

import numpy as np
import faiss
import torch
from pypdf import PdfReader
from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForSeq2SeqLM
from google.colab import files

def extract_pages(pdf_file):
    reader = PdfReader(pdf_file)
    pages = []
    for page_number, page in enumerate(reader.pages, start=1):
        text = page.extract_text() or ""
        if text.strip():
            pages.append({"page": page_number, "text": text})
    return pages

def make_chunks(pages, max_chars=600):
    chunks = []
    for page in pages:
        paragraphs = [p.strip() for p in page["text"].splitlines() if p.strip()]
        buffer = ""
        for paragraph in paragraphs:
            # Split very long paragraphs to keep chunks within max_chars.
            while len(paragraph) > max_chars:
                if buffer:
                    chunks.append({"text": buffer, "page": page["page"]})
                    buffer = ""
                chunks.append({"text": paragraph[:max_chars], "page": page["page"]})
                paragraph = paragraph[max_chars:]
            if not buffer:
                buffer = paragraph
            elif len(buffer) + 1 + len(paragraph) <= max_chars:
                buffer += " " + paragraph
            else:
                chunks.append({"text": buffer, "page": page["page"]})
                buffer = paragraph
        if buffer:
            chunks.append({"text": buffer, "page": page["page"]})
    return chunks

def main():
    print("Upload a text-based PDF document.")
    uploaded = files.upload()
    if not uploaded:
        print("No PDF was uploaded.")
        return
    pdf_file = next(iter(uploaded))
    pages = extract_pages(pdf_file)
    chunks = make_chunks(pages)
    if not chunks:
        print("No extractable text found. Scanned PDFs may require OCR.")
        return

    print(f"Pages extracted: {len(pages)} | Chunks: {len(chunks)}")
    embedding_model = SentenceTransformer("all-MiniLM-L6-v2")
    embeddings = embedding_model.encode(
        [chunk["text"] for chunk in chunks],
        normalize_embeddings=True,
        convert_to_numpy=True,
    ).astype("float32")

    index = faiss.IndexFlatIP(embeddings.shape[1])
    index.add(embeddings)

    model_name = "google/flan-t5-small"
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_name)
    llm = AutoModelForSeq2SeqLM.from_pretrained(model_name)
    llm.eval()

    def ask_rag(question):
        query_embedding = embedding_model.encode(
            [question], normalize_embeddings=True, convert_to_numpy=True
        ).astype("float32")
        k = min(3, len(chunks))
        scores, indices = index.search(query_embedding, k=k)
        retrieved = [
            {"text": chunks[i]["text"], "page": chunks[i]["page"], "score": float(score)}
            for score, i in zip(scores[0], indices[0])
            if 0 <= i < len(chunks)
        ]
        context = "\n\n".join(item["text"] for item in retrieved)
        prompt = (
            "Answer using only the context below. If the answer is not in the context, "
            "say that the document does not provide enough information.\n\n"
            f"Context:\n{context}\n\nQuestion:\n{question}\n\nAnswer:"
        )
        inputs = tokenizer(prompt, return_tensors="pt", truncation=True, max_length=512)
        with torch.no_grad():
            output = llm.generate(
                **inputs, max_new_tokens=120, num_beams=4, do_sample=False
            )
        answer = tokenizer.decode(output[0], skip_special_tokens=True)
        print("\nAnswer:", answer)
        print("Source pages:", sorted({item["page"] for item in retrieved}))

    while True:
        question = input("\nAsk a question ('exit' to stop): ").strip()
        if question.lower() == "exit":
            break
        if question:
            ask_rag(question)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
note: Based on your Experiment 8 PDF. Corrected chunking for long paragraphs, empty uploads/documents, and FAISS top-k when fewer than three chunks exist. Intended for Google Colab because it uses its PDF upload widget.

name: Cache-Augmented Generation (CAG)
code:
# Run this install command in a separate Colab cell if needed:
# !pip install -q transformers sentencepiece torch

import time
import torch
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForSeq2SeqLM

MODEL_NAME = "google/flan-t5-small"

def main():
    print(f"Loading {MODEL_NAME}...")
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME)
    model = AutoModelForSeq2SeqLM.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME)
    model.eval()
    print("AI model loaded successfully!")

    cache = {}
    cache_hits = 0
    cache_misses = 0

    def generate_answer(question):
        prompt = (
            "Answer the following question clearly and briefly.\n\n"
            f"Question:\n{question}\n\nAnswer:"
        )
        inputs = tokenizer(prompt, return_tensors="pt", truncation=True, max_length=512)
        with torch.no_grad():
            outputs = model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=100)
        return tokenizer.decode(outputs[0], skip_special_tokens=True)

    def cag(question):
        nonlocal cache_hits, cache_misses
        key = " ".join(question.lower().split())
        if key in cache:
            cache_hits += 1
            print("Cache hit! Returning stored answer.")
            return cache[key]

        cache_misses += 1
        print("Cache miss! Generating answer using AI...")
        answer = generate_answer(question)
        cache[key] = answer
        return answer

    while True:
        question = input("\nEnter your question (type exit to stop): ").strip()
        if question.lower() == "exit":
            break
        if not question:
            print("Please enter a question.")
            continue

        start = time.perf_counter()
        answer = cag(question)
        elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start
        print("\nAnswer:", answer)
        print(f"Response time: {elapsed:.4f} seconds")

    total = cache_hits + cache_misses
    print("\nCache hits:", cache_hits)
    print("Cache misses:", cache_misses)
    if total:
        print(f"Cache hit rate: {cache_hits / total * 100:.2f}%")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
note: Based on your Experiment 9 PDF. Fixed indentation errors, normalizes cache keys for case/whitespace, and uses a monotonic high-resolution timer.

# Run this install command in a separate Colab cell if needed:
# !pip install -q scikit-fuzzy matplotlib numpy

import numpy as np
import skfuzzy as fuzz
from skfuzzy import control as ctrl
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def main():
    temperature = ctrl.Antecedent(np.arange(0, 41, 1), "temperature")
    fan_speed = ctrl.Consequent(np.arange(0, 101, 1), "fan_speed")

    temperature["cold"] = fuzz.trimf(temperature.universe, [0, 0, 20])
    temperature["warm"] = fuzz.trimf(temperature.universe, [15, 25, 35])
    temperature["hot"] = fuzz.trimf(temperature.universe, [30, 40, 40])

    fan_speed["low"] = fuzz.trimf(fan_speed.universe, [0, 0, 50])
    fan_speed["medium"] = fuzz.trimf(fan_speed.universe, [25, 50, 75])
    fan_speed["high"] = fuzz.trimf(fan_speed.universe, [50, 100, 100])

    rule1 = ctrl.Rule(temperature["cold"], fan_speed["low"])
    rule2 = ctrl.Rule(temperature["warm"], fan_speed["medium"])
    rule3 = ctrl.Rule(temperature["hot"], fan_speed["high"])

    fan_control = ctrl.ControlSystem([rule1, rule2, rule3])
    fan_simulation = ctrl.ControlSystemSimulation(fan_control)

    try:
        temp = float(input("Enter temperature in °C (0–40): "))
    except ValueError:
        print("Please enter a valid number.")
        return

    if not 0 <= temp <= 40:
        print("Temperature must be between 0 and 40 °C.")
        return

    fan_simulation.input["temperature"] = temp
    fan_simulation.compute()

    speed = fan_simulation.output["fan_speed"]
    print(f"Temperature: {temp:.1f} °C")
    print(f"Recommended Fan Speed: {speed:.2f}%")

    # Optional membership-function plots
    temperature.view()
    plt.show()
    fan_speed.view()
    plt.show()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
note: Based on your Experiment 10 PDF. Fixed invalid identifiers containing spaces (fan_speed, fan_control, fan_simulation) and added input validation. Output can differ from the PDF's illustrative values depending on the actual run.
